description: This file implements a report in Python for the ERPNext system, focusing on share ledger transfers up to a specified date. It retrieves transfer data, formats columns, and handles user filters, particularly for a specific shareholder and date.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point to generate the share ledger report based on filters, retrieving transfer data and defining report columns.

methods.name: get_columns(filters)
methods.description: Defines and returns the columns for the report table based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_all_transfers(date, shareholder)
methods.description: Fetches all share transfer records up to the specified date for a given shareholder, returning them as a list of dictionaries.
